title: tasks.py seed crashes on fresh clone due to uninitialized plugin registry
environment: Windows 11, Python 3.13, clean clone / empty database
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Clone repo into fresh folder: git clone https://github.com/caobahuong/AegisGate.git fresh_dir
2. cd fresh_dir
3. python scripts/tasks.py seed
expected: Database is migrated and demo catalog, governance rules, and simulated executions are seeded cleanly.
actual: Script fails with SystemExit 1 because 'sqlserver_prod' is not found in PluginProfile table.
suspected_cause: scripts/seed_demo.py:59-62 queries PluginProfile without discovering or registering plugins via PluginRegistry first.
suggested_direction: Invoke PluginRegistry.discover_and_register() or register bundled plugins prior to querying target_id in seed_demo.py.

title: CI workflow api-types drift check fails due to uncommitted Phase 4 TypeScript types
environment: GitHub Actions CI / Local Ubuntu & Windows
steps_to_reproduce: 1. python scripts/gen_api_types.py
2. cd frontend && npm run gen:types
3. git diff --exit-code src/types/api.generated.ts
expected: git diff --exit-code exits with code 0 indicating no uncommitted API schema drift.
actual: git diff exits with code 1 showing 100+ lines of changes for /api/executions/page, wait, and last_event_id.
suspected_cause: Phase 4 scale endpoints were merged into backend OpenAPI schema without updating and committing api.generated.ts.
suggested_direction: Run npm run gen:types inside frontend/ and commit the generated api.generated.ts.

title: Frontend CI step Prettier Format Check fails on LiveExecutionMonitor.tsx and SessionCard.tsx
steps_to_reproduce: 1. cd frontend
2. npm run format:check
expected: Prettier reports all files formatted cleanly and exits with code 0.
suspected_cause: scripts/tasks.py check did not include npm run format:check, allowing unformatted code to pass local verification.
suggested_direction: Run cd frontend && npm run format, and add npm run format:check to scripts/tasks.py check.

title: Governance rule type MAX_EXECUTION_TIME is completely ignored at runtime
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Create a governance rule with rule_type='MAX_EXECUTION_TIME', expression='1.0', is_active=True.
2. Submit query 'SELECT * FROM Users WHERE id = 1' through /api/monitor/executions.
3. Inspect GovernanceEngine.inspect_query_and_plan and TimeoutGuard.get_timeout_for_query.
expected: Governance engine validates execution time threshold or TimeoutGuard enforces 1.0s limit instead of 15.0s default.
actual: No violation is raised and TimeoutGuard defaults to 15.0s; rule expression has zero effect on execution.
suspected_cause: core/engine/governance.py:66-124 lacks an elif rule_type == 'MAX_EXECUTION_TIME' clause, and state_machine.py:354 does not pass rule limits.
suggested_direction: Parse active MAX_EXECUTION_TIME rules and pass custom_limit to TimeoutGuard.get_timeout_for_query in state_machine.py.

title: Plugins built with aegisgate_sdk.PluginServer cannot be aborted while executing
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Implement a BasePlugin whose execute() method runs a long query (e.g. 5 seconds).
2. Run via PluginServer(plugin).run().
3. Send 'execute' JSON-RPC request on stdin, followed immediately by 'abort' JSON-RPC request.
expected: Server reads and processes 'abort' concurrently to terminate the active session.
actual: Server blocks synchronously on execute() and does not read or handle 'abort' until execute() completes.
suspected_cause: sdk/aegisgate_sdk/server.py:106-110 iterates over sys.stdin synchronously on a single thread without concurrency.
suggested_direction: Adopt a thread pool or concurrent abort handler in PluginServer matching plugins/sqlserver_plugin/adapter.py.

title: PluginInstaller._safe_extract crashes with unhandled PermissionError on empty/NUL entry name
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Construct a ZIP archive containing an entry named '' or '\x00hidden.py'.
2. Upload via POST /api/plugins/install/zip or call installer._safe_extract(zf, dest).
expected: PluginInstallerError('Unsafe or empty path in ZIP') is raised and HTTP 400/422 returned.
actual: target resolves to dest_root directory; open(target, 'wb') crashes with PermissionError: [Errno 13] (HTTP 500).
suspected_cause: core/engine/plugin_installer.py:223 does not check if not name or not name.strip() before opening destination file.
suggested_direction: Add validation if not name or not name.strip(): raise PluginInstallerError('Empty entry name in ZIP').

title: mcp_server.py submit_execution drops error_message when status is FAILED
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Submit execution that fails with status='FAILED' (e.g. process crash or janitor reap).
2. Call submit_execution() tool from MCP client.
expected: Returned JSON includes 'error_message' describing the worker failure.
actual: JSON payload contains 'status': 'FAILED' but 'error_message' key is omitted.
suspected_cause: core/gateway/mcp_server.py:206 only checks if ex['status'] in ('REJECTED', 'TIMEOUT', 'ABORTED').
suggested_direction: Add 'FAILED' to the status tuple in line 206: if ex['status'] in ('REJECTED', 'TIMEOUT', 'ABORTED', 'FAILED'):.

title: Critical and Serious WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility violations across Dashboard, Tabs and MCP Modal
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Navigate to http://localhost:3000.
2. Inject axe-core into page and execute axe.run().
3. Open MCP Setup modal and execute axe.run().
expected: Zero critical or serious WCAG 2.1 AA violations.
actual: Select elements lack accessible name (select-name), MCP Modal tab references non-existent ID (aria-valid-attr-value), label mismatch.
suspected_cause: Filter <select> tags lack aria-label; tab-claude specifies aria-controls='tabpanel-claude' but element has no matching ID.
suggested_direction: Add aria-label to all <select> elements, ensure aria-controls points to real DOM IDs, and align button aria-label with visible text.

title: GET /api/executions/page silently swallows malformed cursor and returns HTTP 200 first page
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Send GET /api/executions/page?cursor=INVALID_BASE64_GARBAGE.
expected: Endpoint returns HTTP 400 Bad Request indicating invalid pagination cursor.
actual: Endpoint suppresses exception with contextlib.suppress and returns HTTP 200 with the first page.
suspected_cause: core/storage/log_store.py:131 uses with contextlib.suppress(Exception): around base64 decode.
suggested_direction: Raise ValueError on cursor decode failure and handle in api_routes.py with HTTPException(400, 'Invalid pagination cursor').

title: mongodb_plugin is purely simulated mock but requirements.txt and docs imply real driver
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Inspect plugins/mongodb_plugin/adapter.py.
2. Inspect plugins/mongodb_plugin/requirements.txt.
expected: Plugin either implements live PyMongo connection pooling or documentation clearly identifies it as reference mock.
actual: requirements.txt requires pymongo, but adapter.py never imports pymongo or connects to a real database.
suspected_cause: MongoDB plugin was authored as a reference mock architecture demonstrating document store schema extraction.
suggested_direction: Update plugins/mongodb_plugin/README.md and docstrings to clearly state it is a simulated mock reference adapter.

title: is_unbounded_scan heuristic does not detect arithmetic inequality or LIKE tautologies
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Evaluate is_unbounded_scan('SELECT * FROM Users WHERE 1 < 2').
2. Evaluate is_unbounded_scan('SELECT * FROM Users WHERE \'x\' LIKE \'x\'').
expected: Queries with constant tautological predicates are classified as unbounded scans.
actual: Both queries return is_unbounded_scan() == False and bypass the FORBID_TABLE_SCAN check.
suspected_cause: plugins/sql_inspector.py:317-326 only checks operators in ('=', '<=', '>=', '<>', '!=') with identical operand tokens.
suggested_direction: Expand _is_tautology to evaluate basic numeric comparisons (e.g. 1 < 2) and identical string LIKE literals.

title: Inactive Navigation Tabs and Sidebar items fail WCAG AA color contrast in Light mode
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open dashboard in Light theme at http://localhost:3000.
2. Measure contrast ratio of inactive tab labels ('Pluggable Targets', 'Knowledge & Rules', 'Audit Logs').
3. Measure contrast ratio of target items in Sidebar.
expected: Text contrast ratio against white background is >= 4.5:1.
actual: Measured contrast ratios are 2.56:1 (#94a3b8 on white) and 1.23:1 (#e2e8f0 on white).
suspected_cause: Tailwind text-slate-400/500 and inverted light-mode slate tokens render washed out on #ffffff.
suggested_direction: Update inactive tab and sidebar text classes in Light mode to text-slate-600 or text-slate-700 (>= 4.5:1 ratio).
